stdout:
Update a playlist. Use this tool to update a playlist.

Usage:
  yutu playlist update [flags]

Examples:
# Update playlist title
yutu playlist update --id PLxxx --title 'Updated Title'
# Update playlist description and privacy
yutu playlist update --id PLxxx --description 'New description' --privacy public
# Update playlist tags
yutu playlist update --id PLxxx --tags 'music,pop,2024'

Flags:
  -d, --description string   Description of the playlist
  -h, --help                 help for update
  -i, --id strings           ID of the playlist to update
  -l, --language string      Language of the playlist
  -o, --output string        json|yaml|silent
  -p, --privacy string       public|private|unlisted
  -a, --tags strings         Comma separated tags
  -t, --title string         Title of the playlist
      --yes                  Confirm the operation
